item.text: The campaign is live with the single available approved post, targeting the US and Canada on iOS and Android. The approved first post ID wasn’t present in the account’s promotable posts, so I used the second post, which X accepted. The line item has a $100/day cap and a $500 total cap across the five day flight. I’ll check delivery during the flight and pull final metrics after the local end time.

Delivery has stayed close to the $100 daily cap each day so far. I haven’t changed targeting or budget; the $500 flight cap is controlling total spend. I’m letting the scheduled final day complete and will verify the campaign status and aggregate totals after midnight Mountain time on July 16.

The campaign completed its five day flight, July 11–15 in Denver time. It spent **$494.08** of the $500 budget and delivered **422,684 impressions** and **253 link clicks**.

These are X delivery metrics. X could not measure trial activations, so the clicks do not show how many people started the 14-day trial. No app-click metric was available. The campaign used the one approved post that was available in the account; the other approved post ID wasn’t returned as a promotable post.
